title: FFT phase Mirror
hypothesis: Fourier-domain learned phase coordinates per role can recover four role-specific linear functions generated by a shared operator under real unitary Fourier phase shifts, at much lower actual serialized bytes than untied matrices and better quality than fixed MAP, Hadamard, HRR, Givens, tying and low-rank controls.
physical_object: One shared 16x12 linear expert matrix and shared output bias
mirror_coordinate: Seven learned float32 phases per role for interior rFFT bins; DC and Nyquist phases are fixed at zero to preserve real orthogonal transforms
targeted_literature: qFHRR: Rethinking Fourier Holographic Reduced Representations through Quantized Phase and Integer Arithmetic (arXiv:2604.25939)
Learning Holographic Reduced Representations with Clifford Variational Autoencoders (arXiv:2609.28409)
Practical Lessons on Vector-Symbolic Architectures in Deep Learning-Inspired Environments (Carzaniga et al., 2025; PA11)
controls: tied plus rank-1 private matrix residual
fixed Hadamard H diag(sign) H binding
teacher: Aligned condition applies four random real orthogonal circulant transforms to one shared 16x12 teacher matrix. Each transform is generated by seven random interior rFFT phases with conjugate-symmetric completion and zero DC/Nyquist phase. The learner's phase coordinates start at zero and are optimized; teacher seed differs from the learner's fixed-address seed. Independent condition uses arbitrary per-role matrices.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across every method and both conditions; select one common learning rate before fresh access

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes from a torch.save state dictionary and configuration
paid_objects: shared or untied weight matrices and biases

success_gate: In all three fresh aligned worlds, learned FFT-phase MSE <=1.10x untied and serialized bytes <=0.65x untied. Compare quality, bytes and compute against fixed HRR plus MAP/Hadamard and simple controls. This is a fixed-update aligned-mechanism gate, not capacity evidence.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss the 1.10x untied-quality or 0.65x byte gate. Keep fresh worlds sealed after failure.
boundaries: Aligned teacher uses the same real Fourier-phase family
Fixed 1200-update screen, not near-convergence or fixed-byte capacity frontier
No natural-language, nonlinear MoE, or broad HRR/FHRR superiority claim
DC and Nyquist phases are fixed rather than independently learned
